title: A declared name is one edit away from `base64`
description: Cargo.toml declares a declared crate name in Cargo.toml within one edit of `base64`. Cargo resolves these names against the registry, so a name that only looks like the intended crate compiles foreign code into the binary. The name this rule expects is `base64`.
remediation: Confirm the intended name against the package documentation the project already trusts and pin the declaration to that exact name; a name that is one edit away from a widely used package is a typo until the project can show it published the name itself. If the declaration was meant to be `base64`, correct it to that exact spelling.
limitation: It compares declared names with `base64` by Levenshtein distance of one and reports a name that is not `base64` itself; it cannot tell whether the similarly spelled package exists, who publishes it, whether it is malicious, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
